[[Westwind Preparatory Academy|Westwind Prep]] ([[Phoenix, Arizona]]) | college = [[San Diego State Aztecs men's basketball|San Diego State]] (2010–2013) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = 2013 | career_end = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = *2x [[Associated Press|AP]] Honorable mention [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] ([[2012 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2012]], [[2013 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2013]]) *[[Mountain West Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|MWC Player of the Year]] (2012) * 2x First team All-MWC (2012, 2013) | stat1label = | stat1value = | stat2label = | stat2value = | stat3label = | stat3value = | letter = | bbr = | HOF_player = | FIBA_HOF_player = }} '''Jamaal Franklin''' (born July 21, 1991){{cite web| title = 2012-13 SDSU men's basketball prospectus | publisher = SDSU Athletics | year = 2012 | url =http://grfx.cstv.com/photos/schools/sdsu/sports/m-baskbl/auto_pdf/2012-13/prospectus/prospectus.pdf | accessdate = July 19, 2012}} is an [[United States|American]] [[basketball]] player. He is a 6'5" junior [[shooting guard]] for [[San Diego State University]] and is the reigning player of the year in the [[Mountain West Conference]] and was an [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] in 2012. ==High school career== Franklin played four years at [[Serrano High School]] in [[Phelan, California]], then played his second senior year at [[Westwind Preparatory Academy|Westwind Prep]] in [[Phoenix, Arizona]]. As a junior at Serrano, he led the state of [[California]] in scoring at 31.7 [[points per game]] and was a two-time All-[[California Interscholastic Federation]] selection. In his senior year at Westwind, he averaged 18.5 points and 6.3 [[rebounds per game]].{{cite web| title = Jamaal Franklin bio | publisher = SDSU Athletics | year = 2012 | url =http://goaztecs.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/franklin_jamaal00.html | accessdate = July 19, 2012}} Frankling was rated as the 24th-best shooting guard in the class of 2009 coming out of [[Serrano High School]] and had an [[ESPN.com]] grade of 90. Out of high school, Franklin was offered to play basketball at the following schools, [[Long Beach State University]], and [[San Diego State University]].{{cite web|title=Jamaal Franklin Profile- San Diego State University Official Athletic Site|url=http://goaztecs.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/jamaal_franklin_710066.html|publisher=San Diego State University Official Athletic Site|accessdate=6 March 2013}} Franklin played three different sports at [[Serrano High School]]. He was a stand out athlete in of course basketball, football, and in track and field. Franklin played wide receiver and free safety for the Serrano Diamondbacks. For track and field he was a state high jumper. ==College career== Franklin enrolled at [[San Diego State Aztecs men's basketball|San Diego State]] to play for coach [[Steve Fisher]]. As a freshman, he was part of arguably the best season in school history, as the Aztecs went 34-3 and captured a #2 seed in the [[2011 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|2011 NCAA Tournament]]. Franklin averaged 2.1 points and 1.9 rebounds in 8.1 minutes per game. In his sophomore campaign, Franklin was thrust into the starting lineup as the Aztecs returned only one starter. He responded by averaging 17.4 points and 7.9 rebounds per game and leading the Aztecs to an unexpected shared regular-season title and a #6 seed in the [[2012 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|2012 NCAA Tournament]]. Franklin was named [[Mountain West Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Mountain West player of the year]]{{cite web| last =Zeigler| first =Mark| title =Franklin, Fisher claim top MW honors | publisher =''[[U-T San Diego]]''| date =March 17, 1989| url =http://www.utsandiego.com/news/2012/mar/05/franklin-fisher-claim-top-mw-awards/| accessdate = July 19, 2012}} and was recognized nationally as an [[2012 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] by the [[Associated Press]].{{cite web| title = Two Mountain West Players Receive Associated Press All-America Honors | publisher = Mountain West Conference | year = 2012 | url =http://www.themwc.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/032712aad.html | accessdate = July 19, 2012}} Franklin resisted the lure of the professional ranks and returned to San Diego State in [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2012–13]] for his junior season. ==Professional career== On April 12, 2013, Franklin announced he would forgo his senior season to enter the 2013 [[NBA Draft]]. Franklin hopes to be the second player from San Diego State University to go into the NBA Draft in the last three years. Kawhi Leonard left the Aztecs after his sophomore season to play for the [[San Antonio Spurs]].{{cite web|title=Jamaal Franklin to leave SDSU early for NBA draft|url=http://msn.foxsports.com/collegebasketball/story/Jamaal-Franklin-to-leave-SDSU-early-for-NBA-draft-041213|publisher=Fox Sports|accessdate=16 April 2013}} A number of mock drafts have been projected, putting Franklin to go as a mid or late first round pick.{{cite web|title=Jamaal Franklin leaving San Diego State for NBA|url=http://aol.sportingnews.com/ncaa-basketball/story/2013-04-12/jamaal-franklin-nba-draft-san-diego-state-leaving-school-early-draft-projection|publisher=Sporting News|accessdate=16 April 2013}} ==References== {{reflist|2}} ==External links== *[http://goaztecs.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/franklin_jamaal00.html SDSU bio] {{Mountain West Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year navbox}} {{Persondata | NAME = Franklin, Jamaal | ALTERNATIVE NAMES = | SHORT DESCRIPTION = American basketball player | DATE OF BIRTH = July 21, 1991 | PLACE OF BIRTH = [[Moreno Valley, California]] | DATE OF DEATH = | PLACE OF DEATH = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Franklin, Jamaal}} [[Category:1991 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Basketball players from California]] [[Category:People from Moreno Valley, California]] [[Category:San Diego State Aztecs men's basketball players]] [[Category:Shooting guards]]
